acceptanceCriteria.text: The timeout path preserves a bounded sanitized excerpt of captured `limactl` stderr/stdout in the returned diagnostic.
The stable timeout/error classification remains deterministic and callers can still distinguish timeout from immediate command failure.
Output remains strictly bounded by the existing command-output/evidence limits; no unbounded logs or secrets are persisted.
Regression coverage proves a timed-out fake `limactl` process with diagnostic stderr returns both the timeout context and the bounded provider error.
Empty-output timeouts retain a concise deterministic fallback diagnostic.
Child termination/reaping and stdout/stderr reader cleanup remain race-safe and leak-free.

issue.title: fix(runtime): preserve bounded limactl diagnostics on timeout
